coordinateFrame: Original native glTF coordinates, +Y up and +Z forward
method: Actual Stage skinned-mesh raycasts return native UV and barycentric coordinates; barycentric interpolation of the cached unanimated source skin gives decoded rest positions, including mesh quantization transforms. Invert the recorded preparation scale and origin. Eye bounds follow the visible original eyelids; no symmetric-face assumption.

reviewedPreview.eyeMaterialGate: Parent visually accepted idle/walk/special actual ink face closeups

pixelClaimScope: Exact non-eye pixel equality is checked only during the uncompressed PNG edit. Runtime WebP encoding is lossy and has no exact pixel-equality claim.
